title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Soccer Cup
moral: When you cheer for others, everyone wins.
character_anchor: Bright children's book cartoon illustration, bold outlines, vivid flat colours. {{NAME}}, a young boy with brown hair and blue eyes, wearing a green soccer jersey with a small gold star, white soccer shorts, green soccer cleats, and white socks — same child, same face, same exact outfit in every image.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} found a tiny soccer field in the forest.
The field was no bigger than a rug.
Mice and frogs sat on little flower seats.
Tiny fairies in coloured jerseys kicked a ball.
It was the Fairy Soccer Cup!

pages.content:
{{NAME}} knelt down to look closer.
A fairy with orange wings flew up to his nose.
"Will you be our referee?" she asked.
{{NAME}}'s mouth fell open with surprise.
"Me?" he said. "Yes!" said the fairy.

pages.content:
The fairy gave him a tiny whistle.
{{NAME}} blew it. Tweet!
All the fairies stopped and looked up at him.
Then the game began again.
The ball went this way and that way, so fast.

pages.content:
A tiny fairy tripped and fell down.
She sat on the field and cried a little.
{{NAME}} called out, "You can do it! Get up!"
She looked up at him and smiled.
She jumped up and kicked the winning goal!

pages.content:
The fairies danced and cheered.
They gave {{NAME}} a tiny gold cup.
It fit on the tip of his finger.
{{NAME}} sat back against a big soft tree.
He felt proud and happy and very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the fairy team has a rematch and you are invited back.
